ToDoList is likely the central repository for suggestions and reminders generated by agents, directly supporting the feature.
ToDoItem represents individual suggestions or issues identified by agents, refining the feature's output mechanism.
StandardCM (Control Mechanism) likely manages the execution or scheduling of critics/agents, supporting background analysis.

Poster may be responsible for posting suggestions or issues to the ToDoList or UI, directly supporting agent output.
StartCritics likely initializes or starts the critic agents, directly supporting the feature's runtime activation.
